description: 质量量化锚定测试集（v1.5.2）。每条锚点带自动判定依据：expect_terms 指定译法必须出现在译文（空白归一后包含判定，防 _tidy 插空格误报）；expect_numbers 的数字必须保留；no_leftover 要求无占位符残留；min_chars 防漏译/空译。方向统一为外→中。

anchors.source: Machine learning models require large amounts of labeled data for training.
anchors.notes: AI 基础术语，单次出现

anchors.source: This paper proposes a new neural network architecture that reduces training time by half.
anchors.notes: neural network 易被误译为神经网络系统/神经网

anchors.source: Gradient descent is the most common optimization algorithm in deep learning.
Quantum computing promises to solve problems that are intractable for classical computers.
The global supply chain has been disrupted by port congestion and labor shortages.

anchors.notes: 经济术语 + 数字同现

anchors.source: Climate change is accelerating glacier melt in the Arctic region.

anchors.notes: efficacy 易误译为效率/功效

anchors.source: We ran a benchmark test to compare the two database engines.
Researchers fine-tuned the pre-trained model on domain-specific corpora.
Revenue grew by 15.3%, reaching $4,200,000 in the third quarter.
anchors.notes: 百分比 + 货币大数。刻意避开 million/billion 数量级词——「$4.2 billion 与 42亿美元」的 token 拆解差异是 number_check 已知 TODO（见该模块 docstring），第一版锚定集不踩已知盲区
